note: Corrections to the BodyParts3D source data, applied by scripts/build-atlas.mjs on every build. Each fix can be applied again without changing the result. swapSides: left/right names that contradict where the mesh sits; the pair's names and conceptIds are exchanged (and their single-side concepts), only while the first id is still on the wrong side. rename: a new name; concept adds a search concept for it, like copies the concept memberships of the mirrored part. remove: source parts left out of the atlas, duplicates and the three rotator meshes Z-Anatomy replaces (the concepts that listed them keep their other parts).

rename.name: Intervertebral disk of twelfth thoracic vertebra
rename.why: Unnamed disk between T12 and L1, the only one missing from the series.

rename.name: Set of perforating veins
rename.why: Named right fibular vein, but it sits in the left thigh and mirrors FJ2192 (the other perforating vein sets carry no side either).
